User-agent rotation cycles through multiple agents across multiple requests

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const crawlberg = @import("crawlberg");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try crawlberg.crawl("{\"max_depth\":1,\"max_pages\":3,\"user_agents\":[\"Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) TestAgent-1\",\"Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_15) TestAgent-2\"]}", "https://example.com");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
